values.note: Eight campsites, each with electricity, a gravel parking area and a picnic table. One RV or trailer, two tents and 8 campers per site.

sites.source: https://calhouncountyparkwv.com/camping/ ('The campground contains eight campsites with electricity, gravel parking area, and picnic table') + https://calhouncountyparkwv.com/campground-rules/ + campground map PDF (sites 1-8, electric hookup at each), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bathrooms and showers are in the Community Building beside the campground; water spigots in the campground. A camper bathhouse is 'in the process of development'. Dumpster by the Community Building.

facilities.source: https://calhouncountyparkwv.com/camping/ ('Water spigots are placed within the campground and bathrooms and showers are located in the Community Building') + campground map PDF (water spigots), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Regular camping season Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day; extended for special events (astronomers, family reunions) by advance arrangement.

season.source: https://calhouncountyparkwv.com/fees/ ('Our regular camping season begins Memorial Day Weekend and ends Labor Day. We do extend season for special events for astronomers and family reunions.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Arrange in advance with the park's overseer by phone (304-354-6398) or email; registration forms and fees are paid at the Community Building. Online/credit-card reservations are 'under construction'.

booking.source: https://calhouncountyparkwv.com/fees/ ('Arrangements should be made in advance to secure reservations ... Please contact our overseer ... at 304-354-6398 or email') + https://calhouncountyparkwv.com/reservations/ ('This section is under construction. Credit card reservations and rentals will be available in the future.'), read 2026-10-21

note: Calhoun County Park, 3.5 miles south of Grantsville on Route 16, run by a volunteer board appointed by the County Commission; a designated Dark Sky site. The campground sits behind the Community Building, with gravel pads. The park has ponds but RV-site water frontage is not confirmed. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the county park's own site: 8 electric sites, showers (in the Community Building), Memorial Day-Labor Day season, reservations arranged by phone/email. Added potable water (spigots), booking platform phone. Fees not written: the only rates ($20/night electric for 1-6 days, $15 for 7+, tents $10) are on a fees page last modified 2018-06-17. Not stated: amperage (30-amp left as derived), max rig length.
flags: Missing phone: the park's fees page gives its overseer's number, 304-354-6398, for campground arrangements.

Stale rates: the county park's only camping rates ($20/night with electric, 1-6 days) are on a page last modified 2018-06-17, so no 2024+ rate exists; the reservations page has said 'under construction' since 2018.
